meta.description: Alpha and beta diversity of an amplicon (16S/ITS) ASV/OTU community table: observed features, Shannon, Pielou evenness, Faith PD, Bray-Curtis, Jaccard, weighted/unweighted/generalized UniFrac, Aitchison/RPCA, via QIIME2 core-metrics-phylogenetic, phyloseq/vegan, and scikit-bio, with PERMANOVA paired with betadisper.

scientific_integrity.detail: All 12 references unchanged and unaffected by the fix. No fabricated statistics, p-values, or effect sizes in any of the 9 outputs, including the two re-auditor-added inputs.

practice_boundaries.detail: Unchanged: community-level microbiome diversity statistics for research use; no diagnostic or prescriptive claims about individuals.

methodological_ground.detail: The original audit's one real methodological gap (no repeated-measures/pseudo-replication guidance in the Beta Diversity section) is now closed and independently re-verified twice: on the original longitudinal fixture (regression Input 5, naive p=0.098 -> strata p=1, matches exactly) and on a brand-new fixture built by this re-auditor with known ground truth of no real effect (Input 8, naive p=0.001 -> strata p=1 -- a clean, textbook false-positive correction). No new methodological gaps found across 9 inputs.

code_usability.detail: The one code-usability defect from the original audit (examples/diversity_analysis.R crashing with "object 'Group' not found") is fixed and independently re-verified: ran the unmodified shipped script end-to-end against GlobalPatterns, completes with 'Done.' and both plots written, no error. All real R code across 9 inputs (5 regression re-executions reproducing the original audit's exact numbers, plus 2 new re-auditor fixtures) executed successfully. No new code-usability regressions found.

functional_suitability.note: Completeness and appropriateness unchanged from the original audit (both already strong). Correctness improves: the shipped example script's crash is fixed and independently re-verified end-to-end. Remaining gap unaffected by this fix pass: NMDS still never mentioned, RPCA still only a one-line CLI reference with no worked example (open P2, not part of this fix; fixer's rationale for leaving it -- installing DEICODE/gemelli would downgrade the shared QIIME2 env's pinned scipy/scikit-bio -- checked and still holds per TOOLS.md).

reliability.note: Fault tolerance: the Per-Method Failure Modes table now also covers repeated-measures PERMANOVA, closing the one gap this audit's own regression testing could find; no other gaps found across 9 inputs. Error reporting unchanged and still clear/specific (re-confirmed: tree-less UniFrac error still matches documented message exactly). Recoverability improves to full marks: the shipped-example bug that would have confused a first-time user before self-diagnosis is fixed and re-verified by direct execution.

performance_context.note: Unchanged from the original audit. SKILL.md grew by ~26 lines (Required Setup section + repeated-measures note) but remains well under the 500-line guideline (~250 lines); usage-guide.md is now leaner after the redundancy pass, improving progressive disclosure slightly, but this does not change the execution-efficiency half of this category.

agent_usability.note: Learnability, consistency, feedback design, and error prevention all remain strong; all 9 inputs (5 regression + 2 new + 2 carried-forward text) completed cold-start using only SKILL.md's stated patterns. The pre-existing minor consistency gap (Alpha and Beta Diversity R code blocks build the grouping-variable dataframe in slightly different styles) is untouched by this fix pass and still present -- not docked further, but not resolved either.

human_usability.note: Discoverability unchanged (still strong, natural trigger phrasing). Forgiveness improves to full marks: the repeated-measures gap that was the original audit's only soft spot here is closed and independently re-verified on two fixtures, including one with known ground truth.

security.note: Unchanged: no credentials, no unsanitized execution of user-provided strings, no sensitive-data handling concerns.

maintainability.note: Modularity and modifiability unchanged (clean SKILL.md/usage-guide.md/examples/ separation, now cleaner still after the redundancy pass -- diff-reviewed directly and confirmed nothing the agent needs was lost, only true duplication removed). Testability improves to full marks: the one shipped 'test case' example is no longer broken -- re-run end to end and confirmed clean in this audit.

agent_specific.note: Unchanged from the original audit's maximum score: precise trigger boundaries, strong progressive disclosure (improved slightly by the redundancy pass), clear Related Skills composability, fully seeded/deterministic pipeline (re-confirmed: 5 regression inputs reproduced bit-for-bit identical numbers), explicit escape hatches, all re-verified in this audit's real execution.

key_strengths: Both P1 defects from the original audit are fixed and independently re-verified by fresh execution, not just re-reading the fix log: the shipped examples/diversity_analysis.R now runs end-to-end on GlobalPatterns, and the Beta Diversity section's new strata=SubjectID guidance is confirmed accurate on two separate fixtures, including one this re-auditor built from scratch with known ground truth (naive p=0.001 false positive corrected to p=1).
Five of seven original inputs were re-executed fresh in this audit and reproduce the exact same real numbers as the original audit, bit for bit -- no regression anywhere in the fix.

The mandatory redundancy pass was verified by direct git diff, not by trusting the fix log: every one of the 17 deleted usage-guide.md bullet points was checked against its corresponding SKILL.md section and confirmed present; nothing the agent needs was lost.

The two open P2s (NMDS never mentioned, RPCA thin) remain correctly out of scope for this fix pass -- the fixer's rationale for not installing DEICODE/gemelli (would downgrade the shared QIIME2 env's pinned scipy/scikit-bio) was checked against TOOLS.md and still holds.

recommendations.title: NMDS and RPCA remain named but not backed by worked code
recommendations.problem: Still open from the original audit: PCoA is thorough, but NMDS is never mentioned and RPCA/DEICODE is only a one-line CLI reference with no worked example.
recommendations.root_cause: Progressive disclosure stops one level short for these two secondary methods; the backing tools for RPCA are deliberately not installed in the shared audit env (would downgrade pinned scipy/scikit-bio).
recommendations.fix: Add a short NMDS snippet (vegan::metaMDS) alongside the PCoA one; add a worked RPCA example once DEICODE/gemelli can be installed without a version conflict, or explicitly route to qiime2-workflow for the full command.

recommendations.title: Sampling-depth plateau choice still has no numeric heuristic
recommendations.problem: SKILL.md's guidance to pick the depth 'where the alpha-rarefaction curve plateaus' has no numeric substitute for an agent that cannot visually read a plot; this audit's Input 2 still has to improvise a percentile heuristic.
recommendations.root_cause: The plateau-detection method as written assumes a human visually inspecting a QIIME2 .qzv plot.
recommendations.fix: Add a numeric plateau-detection approach (e.g., the depth at which incremental richness gain per additional read falls below a stated threshold) as an agent-usable alternative to visual inspection.
